read_audio_bytes_with_ffmpeg: read audio bytes through ffmpeg and return a numpy array at a given sampling rate
stream_microphone_audio_chunks: stream audio chunks from the system microphone using ffmpeg with configurable sampling rate and chunk length
stream_live_microphone_with_striding: stream live microphone audio with overlapping stride chunks for real-time inference
iterate_chunked_bytes_with_stride: iterate over raw byte chunks with configurable stride overlaps and streaming partial results
get_windows_microphone_name: retrieve the default microphone device name on Windows via ffmpeg dshow device listing
